programme.title: «Vasa», le galion fantôme
programme.desc: Remonté à la surface en 1961 dans un état de préservation exceptionnel après plus de trois siècles passés sous l'eau, le Vasa est comme une capsule temporelle qui ne cesse de livrer ses trésors.

programme.title: Révélations monumentales
programme.desc: En observant ce monument à toutes les échelles, de l'imagerie satellite aux détails microscopiques, les archéologues, les scientifiques et les historiens dévoilent des révélations inédites sur les histoires d'incroyables monuments.

programme.title: Révélations monumentales
programme.desc: Pétra, en Jordanie, accueille 500 000 touristes chaque année. Parmi les monuments les plus spectaculaires, le Khazneh, un impressionnant temple de 40 mètres de hauteur qui n'a eu de cesse d'intriguer et de fasciner les archéologues.

programme.title: Révélations monumentales
programme.desc: En plein centre de Paris se dresse le palais du Louvre, le plus grand musée du monde, visité par plus de 10 millions de personnes chaque année.

programme.title: C'est un vrai complot !
programme.desc: Le premier épisode explore l'assassinat de Léon Trotski. Le leader communiste, principal opposant à Staline, est mortellement blessé le 20 août 1940 à Mexico, d'un coup de piolet à l'arrière du crâne par un agent de Staline nommé Ramon Mercader.

programme.title: D-Day : au péril de leur vie
programme.desc: Une visite des principaux sites du jour J le long de la côte normande, notamment Omaha Beach et Pegasus Bridge. À découvrir également: les récits des hommes et des femmes qui se trouvaient sur les lignes d'attaque et de défense.

programme.title: D-Day : au péril de leur vie
programme.desc: Giles Milton nous guide à travers les lieux critiques de Normandie où l'invasion du jour J s'est avérée fructueuse le 6 juin 1944. Avec les témoignages d'experts locaux et du vétéran centenaire Trooper William Gladden.

programme.title: Fuite des nazis, la route des monastères
programme.desc: Des milliers de criminels nazis ont profité du chaos ambiant pour fuir l'Europe et échapper ainsi à la justice des tribunaux. Tout cela fut rendu possible grâce à des réseaux d'exfiltration, mais aussi avec l'aide de l'Eglise catholique.

programme.title: Les nazis de Nuremberg
programme.desc: Il y a 75 ans, le plus grand procès pour meurtre que l'histoire ait connu commençait à Nuremberg, en Allemagne.

programme.title: Jusqu'au dernier - La destruction des Juifs d'Europe
programme.desc: Le 17 mai 1942, Reinhard Heydrich, le chef des services de sécurité du Reich et organisateur de la Solution Finale, est tué dans un attentat à Prague. Pour Hitler et Himmler, il faut accélérer et radicaliser le processus d'anéantissement.

programme.title: Jusqu'au dernier - La destruction des Juifs d'Europe
programme.desc: Lorsque l'Armée rouge arrive à Auschwitz, Treblinka et Majdanek, les camps ont cessé de fonctionner et sont quasiment vides, seuls les déportés trop faibles pour avoir été évacués sont encore là.

programme.title: Shérifs vs migrants : la traque américaine
programme.desc: Aux États-Unis, des groupes extrémistes prennent pour cible les immigrants. Hatewatch, un site web américain, surveille le réseau des groupes de haine anti-gouvernementaux appartenant à l'extrême droite américaine.

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Ein Täter meldet sich geständig. Die Geschichte, die Musiker Siggi Prechtl auftischt, ist wirr. Er habe seinen Zwillingsbruder Paul nach einem gemeinsamen Auftritt auf einem Ausflugsdampfer aus Eifersucht in den Starnberger See gestoßen.

programme.desc: In dieser Realityserie nehmen die Männer der Familie Harrison in einer Pfandleihe in Las Vegas schräge Objekte wie Pacman-Automaten, seltene Autogramme und Ritterhelme in Zahlung. programme.title: Expedition Unknown – Mythen auf der Spur
programme.desc: Infos zur Reihe:\n\nIn "Expedition Unknown" begibt sich Josh Gates auf die Spur historischer Mythen, die bis heute Fragen aufwerfen: Von den Pyramiden der Maya über die Seereisen der Wikinger bis zu den legendären Steinkreisen von Stonehenge. Die Serie untersucht fesselnde Geschichtsrätsel und versucht, die Geheimnisse hinter den Ruinen von El Mirador in Guatemala zu entschlüsseln, die von Bäumen und Schlingpflanzen überwuchert sind. Ebenso werden die mutmaßlichen Reisen der nordischen Seefahrer über den Atlantik nach Amerika und die Funktion der Megalith-Monumente nahe der englischen Stadt Salisbury untersucht. Dabei werden spannende Fakten präsentiert und die Meinungen der Experten diskutiert, die oft unterschiedlich sind.

programme.title: Coogans großer Bluff
programme.desc:
Arizona und New York, einen krasseren Gegensatz gibt’s kaum. Und Walt Coogan ist keiner, der da vermitteln könnte: Der eigenwillige Provinz-Sheriff reist in die Metropole, um den flüchtigen Sträfling James Ringerman zurückzuholen. Als der erneut ausbüxt und Coogan ihm in bester Wildwest-Manier hinterherjagt, sind selbst die abgebrühtesten City-Cops entsetzt, allen voran Lieutenant McElroy… 

Nur der Cowboyhut blieb: „Coogans großer Bluff“ war der Auftakt zu Clint Eastwoods erfolgreicher und künstlerisch effektiver Zusammenarbeit mit dem Action-Spezialisten Don Siegel („Nur noch 72 Stunden“, „Der letzte Scharfschütze“). Mit dem Film verabschiedete sich Eastwood vom Italowestern-Image von „Für ein paar Dollar mehr“ und „Zwei glorreiche Halunken“. Die Rolle des Großstadtbullen perfektionierten Siegel/Eastwood dann drei Jahre später in „Dirty Harry“ und landeten so einen Welthit. 

Übrigens: Aus „Coogan“ entstand in den Siebzigern die Serie „Ein Sheriff in New York“ mit Dennis Weaver. Kaum zu glauben: Kurz nach seiner Aufführung 1968 wurde dem Film von Moralaposteln „unnötige Gewalt“ und „zu viel Sex“ vorgeworfen. Aus heutiger Sicht nehmen sich diese Zutaten allerdings nur noch vollkommen harmlos aus.

programme.title: Vice – Der zweite Mann
programme.desc: Alles begann 1969, als Dick Cheney (Christian Bale) Donald Rumsfelds (Steve Carell) persönlicher Assistent wurde. 2001 gehörten beide zur Regierung unter Präsident George W. Bush (Sam Rockwell), Rumsfeld als Verteidigungsminister, Cheney als zweiter Mann im Weißen Haus. Nach den Anschlägen vom 11. September prägte der „Vize“ die US-Außenpolitik nachhaltig. Viele seiner Entscheidungen sind bis heute spürbar. \n\nNeben dem großartigen Cast setzt McKay wie bei „The Big Short“ auf das Spiel mit der Erwartungshaltung der Zuschauenden. Wieder durchbricht ein Erzähler die vierte Wand, der Regisseur entwirft alternative Erzählstränge und füttert das Publikum mit zusätzlichen Fakten. Virtuos und mit subtil-bissigem Humor zeichnet er so das Porträt eines Machtmenschen.

programme.title: John Wick
programme.desc: Nach dem Tod seiner Frau hat John Wick (Reeves), eine Legende im Metier der Profikiller, seine Waffen einzementiert. Er lebt zurückgezogen, seine ganze Freude ist ein junger Hund. Als der Sohn des Paten Tarasov und seine Gang Wick verprügeln, sein Hundchen töten und sein schickes Auto klauen, entfesselt der Killer ein derartiges Rache-Inferno, dass selbst der mächtige Tarasov (Michael Nyqvist, „Verblendung“) das Schlottern kriegt… \n\nBill von „Bill & Ted“, Neo in „Matrix“ und nun John Wick: Keanu Reeves mag kein großer Mime sein, aber er hat ein Händchen für Kultrollen in genreprägenden Filmen. Das stilistisch beachtliche Regiedebüt der Stuntmen Chad Stahelski und David Leitch ist ein durchchoreografierter Action-Meilenstein. Die harte Gewalt wird durch den märchenhaften Kosmos rund um das „Continental“ kompensiert, ein Hotel nur für Unterweltler.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Infos zur Serie:\n\nIn diese Kult-Serie liegt es an Geheimagent Angus MacGyver (Richard Dean Anderson), die besonders schwierigen Fälle zu lösen. Durch seine besonderen Talente hilft er der „Phoenix Foundation“, die Entstehung von Katastrophen zu umgehen. Dabei verlässt er sich auf möglichst gewaltfreie Lösungen: Er besiegt den Feind mit einer Erfindung aus Streichhölzern und einem Kaugummipapier. Die Serie begeisterte sieben Staffeln lang die Zuschauer.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Infos zur Serie:\n\nIn diese Kult-Serie liegt es an Geheimagent Angus MacGyver (Richard Dean Anderson), die besonders schwierigen Fälle zu lösen. Durch seine besonderen Talente hilft er der „Phoenix Foundation“, die Entstehung von Katastrophen zu umgehen. Dabei verlässt er sich auf möglichst gewaltfreie Lösungen: Er besiegt den Feind mit einer Erfindung aus Streichhölzern und einem Kaugummipapier. Die Serie begeisterte sieben Staffeln lang die Zuschauer.

programme.title: Doppelmord
programme.desc:
Der Segeltörn von Libby (Ashley Judd) und Nick (Bruce Greenwood) ist ein Traum. Bis sie in einem blutbesudelten Bademantel erwacht. Von Nick fehlt jede Spur. Libby wird des Mordes angeklagt und verurteilt. Zu Unrecht: Nick hat seinen Tod nur vorgetäuscht, um mit der Versicherungsmillion, Sohn Matty und Libbys Freundin abzutauchen. 

Nach der Begnadigung will die Betrogene dem Mistkerl ans Leder. Das US-Gesetz legt ihr da keine Steine in den Weg. Es besagt, dass niemand zweimal für dieselbe Straftat verurteilt werden kann. Libby muss nur noch ihren Schatten abschütteln: Bewährungshelfer Travis (Tommy Lee Jones) folgt ihr auf Schritt und Tritt…

Regisseur Bruce Beresford braucht trotz Anleihen bei „Auf der Flucht“ viel Zeit, um den vorhersehbaren Routinekrimi anzuschieben. Das US-Publikum war von „Selbstjustitia“ Ashley Judd dennoch begeistert.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc:
„Ich lebe den Traum.“ Ja, und ob! Jungverleger und Frauenheld David Aames (Tom Cruise) bringt erfolgreiche Magazine heraus, hat ein tolles Apartment, einen Sportwagen, einen guten Freund (Jason Lee) und ein lockeres Verhältnis mit der heißen Julie (Cameron Diaz). 

Auf seiner Geburtstagsparty lernt er die schöne Sofia (Penélope Cruz) kennen und verliebt sich zum ersten Mal richtig. Nach einer Nacht in Sofias Wohnung lauert ihm die eifersüchtige Julie auf. Sie lockt ihn in den Wagen und brettert los. David überlebt mit völlig zertrümmertem Gesicht in einem surrealen Albtraum zwischen Traum und Wirklichkeit…

Cameron Crowes mysteriöses Verwirrspiel ist ein Remake des spanischen Thrillers „Abre los ojos“. Die Liebesszenen zwischen Penélope Cruz und Tom Cruise („Collateral“) kochen förmlich vor Erotik. Kein Wunder: Die beiden entdeckten während der Dreharbeiten tatsächlich ihr Herz füreinander und waren danach ein Paar.

programme.title: Even Money
programme.desc: Episodendrama um Gier und Spielsucht. Top besetzt – u. a. mit Kim Basinger, Ray Liotta, Danny DeVito, Forest Whitaker –, aber zäh und oberflächlich.

programme.title: Dressed To Kill
programme.desc: Mord im Lift: Die Hure Liz Blake (Nancy Allen) wird Zeugin, wie Kate Miller bestialisch mit einem Rasiermesser zerschlitzt wird. Die Täterin, eine große Blondine mit Sonnenbrille, kann fliehen. Liz bangt nun um ihr eigenes Leben. Gemeinsam mit Kates halbwüchsigem Sohn Peter (Keith Gordon) macht sie sich auf, die Klingenkillerin zu fassen. Eine erste Spur führt zum Psychiater Dr. Robert Elliott (Michael Caine), der die sexuell frustrierte Kate behandelt hat. In dessen Kartei, so hoffen die Amateurdetektive, könnte ein wichtiger Hinweis stecken…\n\nRegisseur De Palma, erklärter Bewunderer von Alfred Hitchcock, macht seinem Vorbild alle Ehre. Die brillante Fahrstuhlsequenz ist natürlich eine Reminiszenz an Hitchcocks legendären Duschmord in „Psycho“.

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: Als eine Bürgermeisterin ein Bauprojekt mit dem ersten Spatenstich einweiht, bringt sie damit die Leiche ihrer Pressereferentin ans Tageslicht. Der Ökoterrorist Jasper wird verdächtigt, beteuert aber seine Unschuld. Verzweifelt kidnappt er Mentalist Jane (Simon Baker).

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk und Natalie fischen im Dunkeln
programme.desc: Sharona (Bitty Schram) ist weg. Monks (Tony Shalhoub) Assistentin heiratet ihren Ex-Mann. Wie kommt der von zahllosen Phobien gebeutelte Kauz nun allein zurecht? Gar nicht! Doch das Schicksal meint es gut mit ihm. Als er einen mysteriösen Einbruch untersucht, lernt er die patente Mutter Natalie Teeger kennen: „Mr. Monk und Natalie fischen im Dunkeln“. \n\nÜberzogene Gagenforderungen katapultierten Bitty Schram aus der Serie. Fans werden sie vermissen, obwohl Nachfolgerin Traylor Howard ihre Sache wirklich gut macht.

programme.title: Kabel Eins :newstime
programme.desc: In dieser Nachrichtensendung informieren Moderatorin Angela van Brakel und Moderator Norbert Anwander live im Wechsel über die wichtigsten, tagesaktuellen Geschehnisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft und Sport.

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk gegen den toten Mörder
programme.desc: Krimi-Autor John Rica wurde ermordet. Indizien lenken den Verdacht auf Actionfilm-Star Sonny Chow, über den Rica kürzlich eine wenig schmeichelhafte Biografie veröffentlicht hatte. Nur: Chow ist bereits vor sechs Jahren verstorben. Sogar für Monk ist der Fall verstrickt. Wie passen die Puzzleteile aus Motiven und Todesdaten zusammen?

programme.title: Abenteuer Leben täglich
programme.desc: Das Wissensmagazin liefert die tägliche Dosis Verstand, Service und Information mit echtem Aha-Effekt: Ob faszinierende Technik-Gadgets, DIY-Projekte, Reise-Reportagen oder verblüffende Alltagsmythen – das Moderationsteam rund um Tommy Scheel, Seraphina Kalze und Madita van Hülsen beantwortet komplexe Fragen unterhaltsam, verständlich und nah am Leben.

programme.title: Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal – Der Profi kommt
programme.desc: In Niederkassel will Florian im „Frank Long“ mit amerikanischem Streetfood und BBQ überzeugen. Der Name seines Restaurants ist Programm: den Hotdog neu zu interpretieren. Der wurde nämlich früher einfach nur Frankfurter bzw. Footlong genannt.

programme.title: Achtung Kontrolle! Wir kümmern uns drum
programme.desc: Ob ein Einsatz bei einem schweren Unfall, ein Nachbarschaftsstreit oder der Alltag an der Polizeiakademie: Das „Achtung-Kontrolle!“-Team ist mit Bodycams und 360-Grad-Kameras hautnah dabei. \n\nDie Reportagereihe gewährt spannende Einblicke in den Berufsalltag begleitet diese bei Streifen, Kontrollen und Einsätzen.

programme.title: Battleship
programme.desc:
Ein sonniger Tag vor der Küste Hawaiis: Verschiedene Nationen haben sich im Pazifik versammelt, um an einem Flottenmanöver unter Befehl des Navyadmirals Shane (Liam Neeson) teilzunehmen. Unter ihnen ist auch Heißsporn Hopper („John Carter“ Taylor Kitsch), für den der Einsatz aufgrund einer disziplinarischen Verfehlung jedoch der letzte sein wird. 

Zunächst läuft alles nach Plan – bis auf einmal aus dem Meer gigantische Plattformen emporschießen und sich in unüberwindbare Waffensysteme verwandeln: Das Schicksal der Welt scheint besiegelt. Doch haben die außerirdischen Invasoren nicht mit Hopper und dessen Crew (u. a. Rihanna) gerechnet…

In diesem dummdreist bei Michael Bay abgekupferten 200-Mio.-Dollar-Militärwerbefilm müssen am Ende sogar Veteranen und Versehrte ran.

programme.title: Predator 2
programme.desc:
Los Angeles im Jahr 1997: Auf den Straßen ist, um Police-Detective Harrigan (Danny Glover) zu zitieren, „die Kacke am Dampfen“. Verbissen liefert sich der Cop Feuergefechte mit Dealern, Drogenjunkies, Attentätern oder Voodoo-Priestern. Doch diese Typen sind nur ein „Fliegenschiss“ gegen den Gegner, der da plötzlich aus den Weiten des Weltalls auftaucht: der Predator.

Das eklige Monster stinkt, kann schwer bewaffnete Männer meterhoch in die Lüfte werfen und frisst am liebsten Menschenfleisch. Harrigan heftet sich an seine Fersen. Seltsam: Bundesagent Keyes (Gary Busey) ist ihm stets einen Schritt voraus. Woher hat der Mann seine Informationen?

1987 führte Arnold Schwarzenegger den fast aussichtslosen, aber kommerziell erfolgreichen Kampf gegen das Biest. Auf dieses trick- und actionreiche Sequel musste er verzichten: „Arnie“ wollte zu viel Geld.

programme.title: Blade of the 47 Ronin
programme.desc: Der rachsüchtige Magier Yurei (Daniel Southworth) kommt nach Budapest, um die letzten Nachfahren der 47 Ronin zu töten. Als er sich endlich am Ziel wähnt, entpuppt sich aber US-Girl Luna als letzter Spross aus der Blutlinie der Ronin.\n\nDie Fortsetzung von „47 Ronin“ (2013). Bei uns ging’s jedoch direkt ins Heimkino.

Verbissen liefert sich der Cop Feuergefechte mit Dealern, Drogenjunkies, Attentätern oder Voodoo-Priestern. Doch diese Typen sind nur ein „Fliegenschiss“ gegen den Gegner, der da plötzlich aus den Weiten des Weltalls auftaucht: der Predator.

Das eklige Monster stinkt, kann schwer bewaffnete Männer meterhoch in die Lüfte werfen und frisst am liebsten Menschenfleisch. Harrigan heftet sich an seine Fersen. Seltsam: Bundesagent Keyes (Gary Busey) ist ihm stets einen Schritt voraus. Woher hat der Mann seine Informationen?

1987 führte Arnold Schwarzenegger den fast aussichtslosen, aber kommerziell erfolgreichen Kampf gegen das Biest. Auf dieses trick- und actionreiche Sequel musste er verzichten: „Arnie“ wollte zu viel Geld.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier
programme.sub-title: Schere ist ein ganz Lieber; Papiers Familientreffen
programme.desc:
Infos zur Serie:

Schere, Stein und Papier teilen sich eine Wohnung – für beste Freunde doch selbstverständlich. Aber im Alltag ist das Zusammenleben dann doch nicht immer so einfach und so versinkt die WG regelmäßig im Chaos. 

Schere ist der lockere Spaßvogel, der selten etwas ernst nimmt und mit seinem Humor gerne die anderen auf die Palme bringt. Stein hingegen ist modebewusst, charmant und der gefühlvolle Ruhepol der Gruppe. Und dann gibt’s noch Papier – das kreative Genie, das mit seinen cleveren Erfindungen (fast) immer eine Lösung parat hat.

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show
programme.sub-title: Eine Hexe bleibt eine Hexe; Die Oma Tentakel Show
programme.desc: Infos zur Serie:\n\nIn dieser verrückten Show bekommt Patrick Star endlich seine eigene Bühne! Der liebenswerte, aber etwas chaotische Seeigel führt eine Talkshow, die genauso wild und unvorhersehbar ist wie er selbst. Mit seinen skurrilen Gästen, seinem schrägen Humor und jeder Menge Absurditäten wird die Show garantiert für Lacher sorgen – auch wenn nichts so läuft, wie es sollte!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Finale der zweiten von drei Staffeln um den zwölfjährigen Aang, der die Herrscher des Feuers auf ihrem Weg zur Weltherrschaft stoppen will. Als Katara, die letzte Gebieterin des Wassers, in Gefahr gerät, eilen ihr Aang, Sokka und Toph zu Hilfe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Zum Ende der letzten Staffel verletzte sich der Avatar schwer und auch die dritte Staffel beginnt mit einem Paukenschlag: Aang, Herr über alle Elemente, erwacht auf einem Schiff der Feuernation – wo werden sie ihn nur hinbringen? Und wie soll der 12-Jährige seine Bestimmung erfüllen, die Welt wieder in Ordnung zu bringen? Aber da sind ja noch seine treuen Freunde….

programme.title: De Feesttafel
programme.desc: Peppe Giacomazza gaat vandaag voor het beste uit de Italiaanse keuken op zijn feesttafel met een verfijnd gepocheerd eitje, open ravioli met kreeft en een Siciliaanse taart. Maar een geslaagde avond eindigt volgens hem sowieso met affogato.

programme.title: Becoming Meewis
programme.desc: Intieme inkijk in de keuken van tweesterrenrestaurant De Slagmolen, waar vader en zoon Bert en Giel Meewis samen met hun team hun topproducten, verfijnde gerechten en dagelijkse keukenritme onthullen.

programme.title: Streetfood
programme.desc: Spicy taco's, loaded fries, bakjes vol Oosterse goodies: dat is streetfood. Vandaag start streetfoodie Lynn in haar Hometown Amsterdam en gaat ze bij de hippe Market 33 heerlijk eten van de straat ontdekken en ook zelf klaarmaken.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: In Swansea ontdekt Chris vurige smaken van Jamaicaanse kip, vlamgrillt hij verse vis aan het strand en kookt hij met jonge culinaire talenten.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: De ultieme winterse kost van Wim is een ovenschotel Parmentier, maar dan net iets anders. Daarna gaat ook zijn winterse traybake en zijn Orloffgebraad de oven in. En dan is er nog dessert: homemade vanillepudding met speculaas.

programme.title: Bon Appetit
programme.desc: De chefs smeren hun beentjes al in, want vandaag is het aan de Marokkaanse wervelwind Zohra Aït Fath. Op haar programma staat een cursus messen vervaardigen en een portie nostalgie met sardientjes, kippenbrochettes en zoete couscous.

programme.title: De Feesttafel
programme.desc: Peppe Giacomazza gaat vandaag voor het beste uit de Italiaanse keuken op zijn feesttafel met een verfijnd gepocheerd eitje, open ravioli met kreeft en een Siciliaanse taart. Maar een geslaagde avond eindigt volgens hem sowieso met affogato.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Smossen is toegestaan bij de Sloppy Joe burger die Timon vandaag maakt op basis van vers gedraaid varkensgehakt. Daarna verleidt hij elke fan (en misschien ook de twijfelaars) van lamsvlees met zijn lamscurry, flatbread en kruidige rijst.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: De Winterse Kost van Wim is vandaag de Griekse ovenschotel waar we allemaal zo verzot op zijn: moussaka. Wim volgt het klassieke recept, maar zorgt voor een extra krokant, goudbruin korstje.

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: Foodies Lynn, Tess en Maud stranden in het centrum van West-Vlaanderen, in Roeselare. Ze ontdekken er de lokale likeur én de lokale natuur op een prachtige plukboerderij. De meiden maken ook hun eigen houten tapasplanken.

programme.title: Sarah's Sweet Table
programme.desc: Sarah is dol op karamel! Vandaag staan er twee zalig zoete desserts met karamel op haar Sweet Table te blinken: een luchtige cake met gekaramelliseerde ananas en chocoladetoffees in een nostalgische snoepverpakking. Een heerlijke plakboel!

programme.title: Becoming Meewis
programme.desc: Met Pomme Moscovite - of Pomme Tsarines - als leidraad toveren Bert en Giel twee totaal verschillende luxegerechten op het bord. Altijd afgewerkt met kaviaar en op een bedje van heerlijk gepureerde aardappelen.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: Simpel, maar goed. Zo heeft Bart zijn winterse kost het liefst. Vandaag maakt hij tartiflette met prei, ham en Belgische kaas klaar. Hij serveert er ook nog een fris tomatenslaatje bij.

programme.title: Bon Appetit
programme.desc: Actrice Ini Massez draait saucissen zoals vroeger met Wim en vaart later per kano door het Venetië van de Périgord. Jeroen verrast haar met hartige wafels en Wim ontroert met een nostalgische portie advocaat en Aalsterse vlaaikes.

programme.desc: Fanol Komani ist wegen Diebstahl und Körperverletzung angeklagt. Das Opfer erkennt während der Gerichtsverhandlung Komani eindeutig als Täter. Aber Richter Greinert versucht mit allen Mitteln, den Zeugen Weigand zu verunsichern.

programme.title: Die Kanzlei
programme.desc: Markus Gellert muss seine Tochter Marleen vor dem Gefängnis bewahren. Marleen ist verhaftet worden. Sie soll in der vergangenen Nacht einen Fußgänger angefahren und dann Fahrerflucht begangen haben. Marleen kann sich an nichts mehr erinnern.

programme.title: Hauptstadtrevier
programme.desc: Mariannes beste Freundin Vera will heiraten. Doch im Brautmodengeschäft bricht Veras Bräutigam Konstantin zusammen. In der Klinik wird multiples Organversagen aufgrund einer Blausäurevergiftung festgestellt. Konstantin fällt ins Koma, schwebt in Lebensgefahr. Wie konnte die giftige Substanz in Konstantins Körper gelangen? Konstantin arbeitet zu Hause als Übersetzer, lebt gesund und kauft im Ökoladen ein.

programme.title: Hauptstadtrevier
programme.desc: Als Jürgen und Patrick Klug versuchen, die 18-jährige Mia Kulick wegen Schwarzfahrens zu verhaften, droht diese, sich umzubringen. Gemeinsam können Vater und Sohn verhindern, dass das Mädchen sich mit einer zerbrochenen Bierflasche verletzt. Im Dezernat versucht Julia Klug, das Vertrauen von Mia zu gewinnen. Aber die junge Frau ist genauso verstockt wie verzweifelt.

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Torben lässt der Fall `Nora Franke' keine Ruhe, sehr zum Leidwesen von Carla. Als er von der angeblich 70-jährigen `Nora Franke' angerufen wird, bleibt er misstrauisch und will sie sehen. Gerade als er auf der Suche nach ihr aufbrechen will, steht die ominöse alte Nora Franke vor seiner Tür. Auch Volker will vorerst in Lüneburg bleiben, weil ihn Nora sehr interessiert. Als Alibi verlängert er seine Beratertätigkeit bei Thomas im Rathaus.

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Mithilfe einer ehemaligen Beamtin vom LKA, die sich als 70-jährige Nora Franke ausgibt, kann Torben beruhigt werden. Carla und Nora sind froh, dass Torben seine Verdächtigungen endlich einstellt. Nora bietet Lasse an, im Campingbus übernachten zu können, wofür er dankbar ist. Als er aber zufällig einen Streit in der Hotel-Lobby zwischen der Schlagerdiva Betty Kayser und ihrem Manager-Mann Joey schlichten will, wird Nora zu Boden geschubst und Lasse reagiert sehr merkwürdig.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Werner geht auf Rosalies Angebot ein, Felix zu beeinflussen. Er wird in seinen Träumen von Barbara heimgesucht und will sich von Evelyn ein leichtes Schlafmittel verschreiben lassen. Alfons sieht eine Frau, die Barbara zum Verwechseln ähnlich sieht.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Die blonde Sylvia Wielander hat eine erstaunliche Ähnlichkeit mit Barbara. Werner alarmiert die Polizei, und die Spekulationen am Hotel überschlagen sich. Sylvia weiß nicht, wie ihr geschieht, doch Felix glaubt ihr ihre Geschichte nicht.

programme.title: Der Verdacht des Mr. Whicher

programme.sub-title: Bis dass der Tod uns scheidet

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E03 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Fernando Platas, clavadista olímpico y uno de los referentes más destacados del deporte mexicano. Desde sus primeros acercamientos a la natación y el patinaje acuático hasta convertirse en medallista olímpico y Panamericano, comparte su trayectoria marcada por disciplina, pasión y la constante búsqueda de la perfección. Fernando Platas habla sobre su preparación física y mental, la presión de las competencias internacionales, los Juegos Olímpicos de Barcelona, Atlanta y Atenas, y la importancia del apoyo de entrenadores y familiares. Entre anécdotas de sus clavados, aprendizajes y la construcción de un legado, dentro y fuera del deporte, nos ofrece una visión inspiradora de cómo la dedicación y la disciplina pueden formar no solo atletas, sino campeones de vida.

programme.desc: Platicamos con Paola Longoria, la máxima exponente del raquetbol mundial, para conocer su historia dentro y fuera de la cancha. Orgullosamente potosina y proveniente de una familia con fuerte arraigo deportivo. La entrevista recorre momentos clave de su trayectoria: desde sus primeros torneos, la conquista del US Open a los 18 años, su debut en los Juegos Panamericanos y los sacrificios que implicó mantenerse como la número uno del mundo. Paola también revela los desafíos mentales que ha enfrentado, la importancia del equilibrio emocional y cómo su equipo se convirtió en su segunda familia. Multifacética, disciplinada e inspiradora, Paola Longoria demuestra que el éxito es fruto de la pasión, la constancia y la visión a largo plazo.

Raul freezes under the pressure, and it looks like he is a sitting duck. But Julia steps in to explain to Raul that the only reason she has so much confidence in battle is because she has him at her side. This fires Raul up, and he battles back to steal the victory. The Barthez Battalion team are eliminated, but they are very gracious in defeat.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Ray And Kai: The Ultimate Face-Off
programme.desc: With Lee losing to Tala early in the match, White Tiger X is a game down, and Kai now steps up to battle for the Blitzkrieg Boys. This round is sure to be intense, as old teammates face off in the dish. Ray will represent White Tiger X, and the world is watching. The pressure seems too much for the players, as Ray collapses from the strain. Somehow he finds the strength to keep going, and the desire to bring Kai down! The intensity rises as the battle continues, with both players on either side of the dish so evenly matched, who can predict which one will walk away with the victory?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The fight is a tough one. In fact, the combatants are going at it so hard that the entire arena is filled with the acrid smell of burnt metal. This seems to be a battle of wills rather than blades as each Blader attempts to summon every ounce of power that they can. In the end, Daichi proves to be the winner, and Rick is devastated. Daichi on the other hand has used so much energy that he passes out. Now it's time for the next round, and it pits Tyson against his former teammate, Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Max face off against each other in the semi-final of the World Beyblading Championships. The two old friends use two totally different blading styles in the dish. Tyson takes the offense while Max hangs back and chooses for a more defensive style. Tyson has a tough time battling Max and when Dragoon starts to lose power he starts his engine gear. When he goes in for the final hit, Max suddenly goes on the offense and starts Draciel's engine gear. Just when it looks like Dragoon is going to be knocked out Tyson cleverly uses Draciel's own power against it and defeats Max! This allows Tyson's team, the BBA Revolution, to move on to the final round of the competition!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three teams qualifying for the finals of the World Beyblade Championships ' the Blitzkrieg Boys, the BBA Revolution, and F Dynasty - the BBA must make a decision. Only two teams can play in the finals, and a format to determine which ones will compete must be decided. Will they stage a mini-round robin tournament between the three teams? Or will the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty, who are both tied for second place battle, with the winner moving on to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in the finals? These questions will all take time to answer - time the various competitors use to catch up with family members. With the PPB All Starz eliminated from the tournament, Max visits his folks and then drops by the local community center where he and Ray first told Tyson they were leaving the Bladebreakers. Tyson goes home to visit Grandpa, and Daichi tags along, making himself a little too at home in the process. Grandpa is impressed by Tyson's newfound seriousness when it comes to his martial arts training. Coach Romero of F Dynasty gives Raul and Julia a surprise when he brings them to visit the circus, which just happens to be in town. The circus is where the siblings grew up, and a heartfelt reunion ensues. At BBA Headquarters, Mr. Dickenson announces the finals format. The two second place teams will indeed face each other first, with the victor getting to advance. Tyson surprises everyone by requesting that his match be a tag-team battle. Kenny gives Tyson his newly created Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, an improved version of Dragoon, which performs well in tag-team practice. Tyson and Daichi are pumped - they couldn't be more ready for their upcoming rematch against F Dynasty.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The entire city is pumped for Tyson and Daichi's rematch with F Dynasty in double-team play. At first, the awesome power of BBA Revolution has Raul and Julia on their heels. Raul manages to save Julia from a stadium out and his big sister lets him take command. Encouraged by the support of their circus family, the brother and sister use their experience and teamwork to push the BBA Revolution to the brink of defeat. Tyson and Daichi are losing strength when they realize they are having the time of their lives. There's nothing like competing against powerful, skilled opponents. The BBA Revolution has one last shot at victory. Can Daichi and Tyson manage to use a risky move from F Dynasty's playbook to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? When Tyson's gambit wins the match, Raul and Julia are stunned to hear the crowd cheering for the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty! They are overwhelmed with pride as Kai leaves the stadium. At last, he will face Tyson for the World Championship.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: When You Wish Upon A Star
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Conspiracy
programme.desc: Conspiracy is a video documentary series that explores the dark and controversial stories behind history's most well-known conspiracies. The series aims to take a neutral position on very polarizing topics while helping viewers uncover the truth.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.sub-title: Aliens Uncovered: The Land of Legends Part 2
programme.desc: In the deserts of Arizona, beneath the vast expanse of the night sky, unseen forces linger, defying explanation and challenging our perception of reality. Journey through time as we explore encounters from Native American folklore to modern sightings, uncovering tales of mysterious crafts, otherworldly beings, and government cover-ups. As we traverse the stunning landscapes of Arizona, we reveal how these legends have shaped a collective fascination with the skies, inviting viewers to ponder: are we truly alone in the universe?

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: A woman vanishes in Oregon, leaving her infant daughter behind. The woman's husband is behaving suspiciously--but he has an airtight alibi and there is no physical evidence of a crime. The case stalls until detectives begin working with psychic Laurie McQuary, who helps uncover the plot behind the woman's disappearance. A single California mother disappears after a night out with friends. Her family begins a desperate search to find her and bring her home. When hope turns to despair, a random phone call from psychic Donielle Patton helps police deliver justice.

programme.title: Sir Spooks
programme.sub-title: Scary Videos You Should NOT Watch Alone
programme.desc: Analysis and presentations of scary videos featuring ghosts, creatures and other mysterious subjects.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: NY Mystery: How Did Sheena Die (Pt 1)
programme.desc: In a headline-grabbing case, 22-year-old Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, just hours after reports of an altercation between Sheena and her fiancé, Joe, now 48. Her death was ruled a suicide, but Sheena's parents refuse to believe that their daughter would take her own life -- they feel she was murdered, and that Joe may be responsible. In an effort to clear his name, Joe comes face to face with Sheena's mother and father, Kelly and David, on Dr. Phil's stage. What does Joe say happened on the night Sheena was last seen alive? And, how does his story differ from the one Kelly and David say they've pieced together? Listen to 911 calls from that night, including one from Sheena herself. Tune in and decide for yourself: Is there more to this story than Joe is revealing?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Mom Didn't Fight for Me
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Husband Doesn't Want Me as a Business Partner
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: I Don't Trust I'll Find Someone to Create a Life With
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: Relationships and Your Spiritual Journey
programme.desc: Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: How to Have Miraculous Relationships
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: Relationships Are Opportunities for Growth
programme.desc: The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: La periodista Flor Alba Núñez fue asesinada en 2015 en Pitalito. “El Loco” y “El Chori” fueron condenados por el crimen. Se cree que su muerte estuvo ligada a denuncias periodísticas, incluyendo corrupción política y otros hechos locales.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Una mujer que tiene la capacidad de engañar sus tres ex esposos y asesinarlos. Estos tres hombres encuentran un destino fatal cuando caen en las redes del amor de Esneda, pero ninguno de ellos conoció las verdaderas intenciones que se escondían tras la atractiva y convincente mujer, sometiendo la voluntad de ellos a quienes convirtió en sus aparentes maridos, con el único objetivo de cobrar un seguro de vida donde ella era le beneficiaria.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2014, en Medellín, Luis Felipe Muñoz Masías, de 16 años, fue asesinado por su propio padrino, Jesús Giraldo, quien lo sometía a abuso sexual desde hacía años. En un ataque de celos, Giraldo lo atacó con un arma contundente causándole la muerte. La investigación reveló una historia de obsesión y esclavitud sexual. Giraldo enfrenta cargos por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento a menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Alfredo Padilla mantenía relaciones con las hermanas Wendy y Karime Gómez sin que ninguna lo supiera. Tras su desaparición, la policía halló su cuerpo enterrado en la casa de las hermanas. Wendy confesó haberlo envenenado y contratado a un obrero para enterrarlo. Fue condenada a 20 años de cárcel por homicidio agravado, mientras Karime enfrenta un proceso judicial para probar su inocencia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Katherin desapareció el 15 de mayo de 2017 tras viajar a Bucaramanga. Su ex, un militar llamado Elisaldo Aguilar, no aceptó el fin de la relación y usó una millonaria propuesta como trampa para asesinarla.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Los Informantes

Tras años de maltrato y trabajo forzado, logró rehacer su vida. Décadas después, su hermana Andrea la encontró a través de una foto en redes sociales, y juntas se reencontraron tras años de búsqueda y dolor.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Elena Sada, sobreviviente de los Legionarios de Cristo, revela en 'Los Informantes' el abuso sistemático del padre Marcial Maciel, quien victimizó a decenas de niños. Durante 20 años, Sada vivió privada de libertad dentro de la secta, incluso reclutando nuevos miembros, hasta escapar y reconstruir su vida. Hoy narra su testimonio en el libro 'El ave negra', exponiendo décadas de encubrimiento eclesiástico.

programme.desc: Tras un año de separación y sintiéndose alertada del regreso de Armando a Venezuela Finita visita su casa al buscar retomar su antiguo romance ahora avalada con el derecho de ser una mujer divorciada - Finita observa con horror la realización de su mas nefasta pesadilla al encontrarse con Natalia quien se presenta ante ella como la novia de Armando. en el local de persianas Botero se autocompadece de su situación como hombre y empleador tras haber perdido a Wilker como su empleado.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta no quiere hablar con Valentina ni con su madre, está muy enojada y no confía en nadie, siente que todos le ocultan cosas. Ana Belén tiene miedo que Valentina le cuente la verdad a Julieta y se haga pasar por victima en vez de la mujer ambiciosa que era cuando le alquilo el vientre. Magdalena y Agustín discuten por la galería de arte y por el hijo que tienen. Agustín chantajea a Magdalena con la tenencia de Rodrigo a cambio de la galería que le pertenece a ella por ser una herencia familiar. Marilyn se imagina a Ricardo como un hombre perfecto. Valentina habla con Efraín y le cuenta que estuvo a punto de decirle toda la verdad a Julieta pero que llego Ana Belén y no lo pudo hacer.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo intenta rescatar a Ricardito mientras enfrenta la enfermedad de Elizabeth, quien necesita una biopsia medular. Katiuska es descubierta visitando a una bruja y abandona la casa de los Tariffi tras ser confrontada. En paralelo, Marcelo y Graciela se divorcian, mientras María del Pilar celebra el suceso. La policía identifica a Carrero como el secuestrador, y Ricardo se dispone a pagar el rescate personalmente, temiendo por su vida y encargando el cuidado de sus hijos a Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Humberto descubre en el cuarto de Eustoquio los documentos del Bramón y se los muestra a Isaías, quien corre a contarle a Blanca: son sus tierras. Amalia enfrenta a Rivero por las acusaciones contra Alejandro; Erasto llega y la galantea. Alejandro sorprende a Carlos declarándole a Rosa que se enamora de ella; los expulsa furioso. Andreína se casa con Robert tras llegar a la iglesia en camioneta. Eustoquio descubre a Consuelo y Blanca buscando los papeles en su apartamento. Erasto invade la recepción y exige a Natalia. Adolfo lo confronta amenazándolo con la policía.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Enzo va a buscar a Milagros a su departamento y en los pasillos se encuentra con Benito, le dice que es vecino de ella y de Luisita… en ese momento se escuchan gritos de Milagros pidiendo auxilio, ya que Artemio Ansola se había desmayado, éste había entrado a la casa de Olga para decirle toda la verdad sobre la hija perdida de Clemencia Talamonti. Enzo y Milagros lo llevan al hospital, donde descubren que Artemio es el esposo de Eulalia, entonces Enzo y Milagros tratan de hablar con Eulalia.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.sub-title: Episodio 20: La vida por un perro
programme.desc: Venancio encuentra a Lázara con Pablo Barranco y éste como es de esperar le hace un escándalo por celos. Sin darse cuenta que Carlos Enrique es testigo de este escándalo escucha toda la discusión de Venancio y Lázara. Allí Carlos Enrique escucha de un tal Pablo y empieza a tener un ataque de celos por Lázara, lo cual lo confunde porque debería estar celoso de su esposa Nancy, pero lejos de ello se enceguece y le pide explicaciones a Lázara sobre Pablo. Cuando Lázara creía que era imposible el romance con Carlos Enrique era imposible por estar casado, éste se presenta pidiéndole explicaciones del tal Pablo. Allí ella se da cuenta que no es ella sola quien está enamorada.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia promete renunciar a su venganza por su amor a Augusto. Augusto se siente culpable de haberla engañado con María Gracia y espera que su historia con ella termine así de rápido como empezó. Artemio Ansola está internado en el hospital que trabaja Augusto, en grave estado debido a la enfermedad que padece. Artemio sabe que pronto va a morir y no quiere llevarse consigo un gran secreto. Él sabe que fue lo que pasó con la hija perdida de Clemencia.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Sin tanto clamor ni culpa, Guillermo busca la excusa perfecta para dejar a Yenny un día antes del gran acontecimiento que significa la boda entre Ana y Cristóbal. Guillermo encontró un perrito abandonado en la autopista, y cuando quiso ingresarlo a su apartamento, Yenny le pidió que se lo llevara a otra parte. Un pequeño e inocuo motivo, pero la gran salvedad para Guillermo que sin sentir un ápice de pena, abandona a Yenny, dejándola sola con su pequeña hija. Y es que esta noticia debe contársela con urgencia a Ana, ya que aún conserva una última esperanza en que ese matrimonio no llegue a concretarse.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras una intensa interpretación de sus personajes en la trama de la película de Junior Graciela y Atanasio se reconcilian llevando así a la realidad sus sentimientos tras hacer pareja juntos en la filmación. En el centro comercial Briggite y Gisela se encuentran para rivalizar una ves mas haciendo alarde de las ofensas que las llevan a herirse la una a la otra - Briggite aprovecha la ocasión para insistir ante Gisela del supuesto y romántico interés que Atanasio siente por ella.
